P_0x008A4B: AI researcher who developed "AI-0," a high-performance combat AI. Former instructor at the Federation Army officers' academy; Aqua Centrum was her student.
P_0x008B5F: Goes by Josh. Son of Felio Radcliff, a Re-Technologist studying Antarctica's mysterious ruins. Has a stepsister, Cliana Rimskaya. Reserved and calm, but shows emotion at times.
P_0x008CD4: Joshua Radcliff's stepsister, excavated from the Antarctic ruins and restored via the Re-Technologists' "Sympatheia" system. Long-term use split her into two aware, conversant personalities (Chris and Riana). Riana is strong-willed and somewhat dry.
P_0x008EBC: Joshua Radcliff's stepsister, excavated from the Antarctic ruins and restored via the Re-Technologists' "Sympatheia" system. Long-term use split her into two aware, conversant personalities (Chris and Riana). Chris is quiet and reserved.
P_0x009095: One of Ruina's pseudo-life forms, the Meliorexe. To revive the "King of Ruin" she needs waves of negative emotion, so she pilots the Fortis Ala in repeated destruction and slaughter. Calm, collected, merciless to those who defy her.
P_0x009F48: A boy who escaped the sealed <Aidoneus Island>. Quiet, few words. Shows rare talent piloting mobile weapons. His past is a mystery.
P_0x00A244: Commander of "GS," the Gaia Sabers, under the <Earth Fed Gov't> President. Near the <Inspector Incident> she approached Graien Grusman via Nibhal Mubhal, earning a special post. Cold, ambitious.
P_0x00A3C2: A Gaia Sabers scientist. Studied <Aerogater> materials at <DC>, then used the data to develop metal cells called <Machine Cell>. Also developed the <Geim System>.
